Metadata.description: Shared care for a loved one: medicines, tasks and visits in one place.

Home.title: Caring for someone close, together
Home.lead: Family, caregiver and the senior in one circle. Everyone knows what needs doing today and who will take care of it.
Home.signIn: Sign in or create an account
Home.signInHint: All you need is your email and a one-time code. No password. Everything is free for now.

create.title: Create a circle
create.text: A circle is the care of one person, for example your mum.

invite.title: Invite your people
invite.text: Send a link to family and the caregiver. Everyone sees only what you allow.

pair.title: Pair the senior’s phone
pair.text: Scan a QR code and you’re done: a big, simple screen with no account or password.

plan.title: Daily plan
plan.text: Tasks for today and the days ahead. One “I’ll take it” and everyone knows who does what.

senior.title: Senior screen
senior.text: The date, the time, today’s plan and big buttons to call loved ones.

numbers.title: Important numbers
numbers.text: Always at hand for the senior, the family and the caregiver.

languages.title: Four languages
languages.text: Polish, Ukrainian, Russian and English. Everyone picks their own.

Home.soon: Coming soon: medication reminders and caregiver visits.

privacy.eu: The database is in the European Union.
privacy.log: The access log shows who viewed the data, and when.
privacy.control: The coordinator decides who sees what and can delete the circle at any time.

seniorDevice.title: Is this the senior’s phone or tablet?
seniorDevice.description: Open the senior screen and pair it with a QR code from the family.

MyCircles.empty: You’re not in any circle yet. Create one for someone you care for, or ask your family for an invitation.
MyCircles.circleDeleted: The circle has been deleted with all its data.
MyCircles.todayCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to do today} one {Still to do today: # task} other {Still to do today: # tasks}}

Login.title: Sign in
Login.lead: Enter your email address and we’ll send you a 6-digit code. No password. If you don’t have an account yet, we’ll create one right away.
Login.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It’s valid for 10 minutes.
Login.devHint: Test mode: emails aren’t sent yet. You’ll find the code in the VS Code terminal where npm run dev is running.

errors.invalidCode: That code isn’t right. Check the digits and try again.
errors.expiredCode: The code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Send a new code.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Welcome.title: Welcome to Krąg!
Welcome.lead: What’s your first name? That’s how others in your circle will see you.

Circles.noContactsManage: Add the numbers of loved ones. The senior will see them on their screen as big call buttons.
Circles.seniorLead: A simple screen on the senior’s phone or tablet: the date, the time and big buttons to call loved ones. No account or password needed.
Circles.leaveLead: You will lose access to this circle’s data. You can only come back with a new invitation.
Circles.onlyCoordinatorLeave: You are this circle’s only coordinator. Before you leave, make someone else a coordinator in the circle settings.

NewCircle.title: New circle
NewCircle.lead: A circle is care for one person. Once it’s created, you can invite family and a caregiver.
NewCircle.name: Circle name
NewCircle.firstName: First name of the person you care for

errors.birthDateInvalid: Please check the date of birth.

CircleData.title: Senior’s details
CircleData.lead: Everyone in the circle who can see the senior’s details will see the changes.
CircleData.addressHint: Useful for a caregiver who visits at home.
CircleData.doctorPlaceholder: e.g. Dr Anna Nowak, Zdrowie Clinic
CircleData.notAllowed: Only a coordinator can change the senior’s details.

Invite.title: Invite to the circle
Invite.lead: Choose a role. You’ll get a link that works once, for 7 days. Send it to that person, e.g. on WhatsApp or by text message.

FAMILY.title: Family member
FAMILY.description: Sees the day plan, medicines, tasks, visits and documents.

CAREGIVER.title: Caregiver or nurse
CAREGIVER.description: Sees what’s needed for care: the address, emergency contacts, medicines, conditions and allergies, the day plan and tasks. Documents only if you allow it.

COORDINATOR.title: Another coordinator
COORDINATOR.description: Can do everything you can, including inviting people and changing permissions.

Invite.linkReady: The link is ready. Send it now: for security, we show it only once.
Invite.shareText: I’m inviting you to the circle “{circle}” in the Krąg app:

errors.notAllowed: Only a coordinator can invite people to the circle.

Join.title: Invitation to a circle
Join.lead: {inviter} is inviting you to the circle “{circle}”. Your role: {role}.
Join.leadNoInviter: An invitation to the circle “{circle}”. Your role: {role}.
Join.signInHint: No account? Your email and a one-time code are all you need.
Join.invalidLead: The link has expired or has already been used. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.

Contacts.title: Important numbers
Contacts.lead: The senior sees these numbers on their screen as big call buttons. The caregiver has them at hand in an emergency.
Contacts.name: Name
Contacts.relationship: Who are they to the senior? (optional)
Contacts.added: Added. The senior will see this number on their screen.
Contacts.full: The senior screen has room for {max, plural, one {# number} other {# numbers}}. Remove one to add a new one.
Contacts.preview: See how it looks for the senior

errors.phoneInvalid: Please check the phone number. Digits are enough, e.g. 600 100 200.
errors.tooMany: There’s no room for more numbers on the senior screen. Remove one to add a new one.
errors.notAllowed: Only a coordinator can change the numbers.

PairDevice.title: Pair a phone or tablet
PairDevice.lead: The senior doesn’t need an account or a password. You show a QR code, the senior’s phone or tablet scans it with the camera and opens a simple screen right away.
PairDevice.nameLabel: What should this device be called? (optional)
PairDevice.qrLabel: QR code to pair the senior screen
PairDevice.step1: On the senior’s phone or tablet, open the camera and point it at the code.
PairDevice.step2: Tap the link that appears, then tap “Pair”.
PairDevice.paired: Paired! “{name}” now shows the senior screen.
PairDevice.remoteLead: Send the link to their phone, e.g. by text message or on WhatsApp. It works just like the QR code.
PairDevice.linkLabel: Link to pair the senior screen
PairDevice.shareText: Your screen in the circle “{circle}”. Open this link on your phone and tap “Pair”:

errors.notAllowed: Only a coordinator can pair devices.

Preview.title: Senior screen preview
Preview.lead: This is what the senior’s phone or tablet shows. The date and time update by themselves, and new numbers appear within a minute.

Settings.title: Circle settings
Settings.lead: Decide who is in the circle and what each person sees.
Settings.peopleLead: Tap a person to change their role or what they see.
Settings.seesAll: Sees everything and manages the circle.
Settings.seesNothing: Sees only the senior’s first name and the people in the circle.

COORDINATOR.title: Coordinator
COORDINATOR.description: Sees everything, invites people, pairs devices and changes permissions.

FAMILY.title: Family member
FAMILY.description: Sees what you allow. By default everything except the circle settings.

CAREGIVER.title: Caregiver or nurse
CAREGIVER.description: Sees what they need for care. Documents only with your consent.

DOCUMENTS.title: Documents
DOCUMENTS.description: Hospital discharge letters, prescriptions and other documents.

MANAGE.title: Circle settings
MANAGE.description: Inviting people, pairing devices and permissions.

Settings.onlyCoordinator: You are the only coordinator, so your role stays as it is. Once you make someone else a coordinator, it can be changed.
Settings.upcoming: Health, tasks, visits and documents come to the app in the next stage. What you set now will apply then.
Settings.logLead: Who viewed or changed data in this circle, and when.

errors.notAllowed: Only a coordinator can change the circle settings.
errors.notFound: This person is no longer in the circle.
errors.lastCoordinator: The circle must keep at least one coordinator.
errors.nameMismatch: The name you typed does not match the circle’s name.

Settings.dataLead: The circle’s name, first name, date of birth, address and doctor.
Settings.deleteLead: We will delete the circle with all its data: the senior’s details, important numbers, invitations, paired devices and the access log. People in the circle will lose access to it, but their accounts will stay. This cannot be undone.
Settings.deleteConfirm: To confirm, type the circle’s name: {name}

AccessLog.title: Access log
AccessLog.lead: Who viewed or changed data in this circle, and when. Entries are kept for 12 months.
AccessLog.empty: The log is empty so far.

Plan.title: Plan and tasks
Plan.lead: What needs doing, when, and who takes care of it.
Plan.overdueCount: {count, plural, one {# overdue task} other {# overdue tasks}}

TaskForm.title: What needs doing?
TaskForm.whenHint: Both are optional. A task without a day goes to the “No day” list.
TaskForm.assignee: Who will take care of it?
TaskForm.showToSeniorHint: E.g. a doctor’s appointment or a grandchild’s visit. The senior will see it in their plan that day.

errors.timeNeedsDate: A time needs a day. Choose a day or clear the time.
errors.notAllowed: You don’t have access to tasks in this circle.

Senior.title: Senior screen
Senior.noContacts: The numbers of your loved ones will appear here. Your family will add them in the app.
Senior.notPairedLead: This phone or tablet isn’t paired with a circle yet.
Senior.unpairedLead: This phone or tablet has been unpaired from the circle. Ask your family for a new QR code.
Senior.howStep1: Someone from the family opens Krąg on their phone, chooses the circle and taps “Pair a phone or tablet”.
Senior.howStep2: On this device, open the camera and point it at the QR code.
Senior.howStep3: Tap the link that appears, then tap “Pair”.
Senior.noAccount: The senior doesn’t need an account or a password.

SeniorPair.title: Pair this device with the circle “{circle}”?
SeniorPair.lead: It will show a simple screen: the date, the time and big buttons to call loved ones. No sign-in, no passwords.
SeniorPair.note: In the circle it will be called “{device}”. The family can unpair it at any time.
SeniorPair.invalidLead: A QR code works once, for 30 minutes. Ask someone from the family for a new one.
SeniorPair.alreadyLead: The code has already been used. The senior screen is ready.

SeniorReady.title: All set!
SeniorReady.lead: This device now shows the senior screen. No sign-in needed.
SeniorReady.installTitle: Last step: an icon on the home screen
SeniorReady.installLead: With it, the senior opens their screen with one tap, like any other app.
SeniorReady.installButton: Add the icon to the home screen
SeniorReady.android: Android: tap the browser menu (three dots) and choose “Add to Home screen”.
SeniorReady.iphone: iPhone and iPad: tap the Share button (a square with an arrow pointing up) and choose “Add to Home Screen”.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.lead: The link may be out of date.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.lead: Please try again. If the error comes back, refresh the page.
